notes.text: דוד משה means Moses’ uncle, not the two personal names David Moshe. שמות פ״ו-יח is Exodus chapter 6 verse 18, not a work called Shemot numbered 86–18. Supplied יח differs from earlier machine וח; no named edition is independently checked.

The linked Sukkah passage names Yonatan ben Uzziel as Hillel’s greatest student, and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1869&lang=en) cites that passage. Exodus names Uzziel among the sons of Kehat. The notice gives the biblical name as a separate reference.
